archive.binding_mode_note: Changed from commit to content_first when the archive was completed. A commit binding requires one commit to change the whole archive-and-source set, and this archive's two source artifacts (tasks/TASK-20260905-2c383f/{report.json,startup_receipt.json}) were committed by the earlier snapshot acb081203 and restored to their release-bound bytes by 4172dca7f. They are immutable, and re-touching them is exactly the error dd8bb7d6f made. content_first binds every declared artifact byte at HEAD instead, per CLAUDE.md 'Archive receipts bind to CONTENT first'; a real reachable commit, its declared parent, and the archival message IDs remain mandatory and are supplied.
